{{Top|leg}}
'''Sound bafflers''' were components that helped to muffle the sound produced by engines. The [[Arakyd Aerodynes, Inc.]] [[Hush-About AJP-400]] used specially designed sound bafflers in tandem with [[auditory dampener]]s to make the [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] virtually soundless.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The [[Whisper (jet pack)|Whisper Jet Pack]] used internal sound bafflers, making it a favorite of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
